updates.title: Log every in-game ER:LC command webhook
updates.summary: Every ER:LC ; command webhook now posts to the VC action log when it arrives, including unknown payloads and failures, so staff can see why a drag did not run.

updates.title: Block priority requests during a peace timer
updates.summary: /request-priority cannot be sent while an in-game peace timer is running, including the 10 minute peace after a priority ends and the 20 minute peace from a LEO briefing.

updates.title: Keep the FD tone off LEO radio
updates.summary: Fire Department tone and Fire dispatch no longer play in the LEO radio channel. The FD tone is now a mono MP3 so Discord does not glitch, and in-game ; commands are not treated as emergency calls.

updates.title: Log in-game ; commands even when they fail
updates.summary: ;ss, ;ts, ;scene, ;fc, ;civ, and ;team now accept the game’s short command payloads (command name without a leading semicolon, numeric userId). Every attempt is posted to the VC action log channel, including failures and the reason.

updates.title: Pause after Fire radio location
updates.summary: Fire dispatch now puts a comma after the location so Brian takes a short pause before calling engine, ladder, and medic 48.

updates.title: Use the station 48 script for Fire radio
updates.summary: Every Fire Department radio call now speaks: Attention station 48 twice, then the fire type reported plus the location, then engine 48, ladder 48, medic 48, and all command please respond. Dumpster fires stay silent.

updates.title: Skip dumpster fire radio for Fire
updates.summary: Dumpster and dumper fires no longer play the Fire Department tone or dispatch line. Structure fires and other Fire 911 calls still announce.

updates.title: Fix in-game events going to Melonly
updates.summary: ER:LC event webhooks are forwarded to Melonly’s live receiver (erlc-wh.melon.ly) instead of the melon.ly/events redirect that was dropping every POST.

updates.title: Use Brian at 1.15x for all bot speech
updates.summary: Priority callouts, in-game call radio, frequency-change greetings, and other spoken lines now use Brian at 1.15x.

updates.title: Use Brian for in-game call radio
updates.summary: LEO, Fire, and DOT dispatch lines now speak with Brian (en-US-BrianNeural) instead of Guy. Priority request voice is unchanged.

updates.title: Speak in-game call radio at 1x
updates.summary: LEO, Fire, and DOT in-game call dispatch lines now speak at normal 1x speed. Priority request voice is still 1.15x.

updates.title: Speak in-game call radio at 1.1x
updates.summary: LEO, Fire, and DOT in-game call dispatch lines now speak at 1.1x. Priority request voice is still 1.15x.

updates.title: In-game calls speak on LEO, Fire, and DOT radio
updates.summary: Cash-register, house, and ATM robberies plus 911 calls now beep and speak on LEO radio. Structure fires and Fire 911 use the FD tone. Every DOT call speaks on DOT radio. The bot joins that team's voice channel, plays the tone, then the dispatch line.

updates.title: Scene commands keep the VC most people are already in
updates.summary: ;ss, ;ts, ;scene, ;fc, and ;civ no longer open a new empty channel when most of the nearby group is already in that scene VC. People already there stay put; only stragglers are dragged in.

updates.title: Scene commands drag nearby players into the same VC
updates.summary: ;ss, ;ts, ;scene, ;fc, and ;civ now also drag anyone within 50 studs in ER:LC into the same Discord voice channel, if they are already in a VC. ;team is unchanged.

updates.title: Fix duplicated PCSO roster callsigns
updates.summary: The next roster sync rewrites duplicated left-column callsigns in the same rank block (Staff Sergeant repeating 2112–2115) and shifts the following 21xx ranks so they no longer overlap. Patrol 1xxx numbers stay put.

updates.title: In-game ;ss ;ts ;scene ;fc ;civ ;team voice drags
updates.summary: Typing those commands in ER:LC now drags you to an empty Discord VC named like Civilian 4. ;team goes to Fire, Police/Sheriff, or DOT voice depending on your in-game team, and does nothing on other teams. You must already be in a Discord VC.

updates.title: Add followers to the pinged default Internet account
updates.summary: -addfollowers now accepts a Discord ping. Followers are added to that member’s default Internet account, not an active alt. @handle still works.

updates.title: Fix Roblox group join-request accepts
updates.summary: Join-request sync now watches both Roblox groups (163783791 and 140437562), can accept with the Roblox cookie if Open Cloud fails, and matches Discord whitelist roles from a REST member list so requests are not stuck waiting.

updates.title: Lower thunderstorm odds on the weather wheel
updates.summary: Thunderstorms are now 4% of weather rolls (was 9%). Clear is 70%, rain 15%, and fog 11%. The 10-minute spin and notj3dah clear override are unchanged.

updates.title: Spin in-game weather every 10 minutes
updates.summary: The weather wheel now rolls every 10 minutes when notj3dah is not in-game (Clear 65%, rain 15%, fog 11%, thunderstorms 9%). Weather is still forced to clear while that player is in-game.

updates.title: Remove the pick up mod calls ping
updates.summary: The bot no longer scare-pings staff to pick up sitting mod calls, and it no longer posts Thank you, for picking up the mod calls. Accepted calls can still be moved into a support voice room.

updates.title: Re-grant soundboard on bot restart
updates.summary: On every bot restart the bot looks up who currently has role 1515129421898448996 and immediately gives them Use Soundboard in both LEO voice channels. An empty roster on boot no longer wipes existing overwrites.

updates.title: Soundboard on a second LEO voice channel, and revoke on role loss
updates.summary: The other-server soundboard role now also unlocks Use Soundboard in main-server voice channel 1514128961951760515. If that role is removed, or they leave that Discord, the bot takes the soundboard overwrites off both LEO voice channels.

updates.title: Grant LEO voice soundboard from the other server role
updates.summary: Members with role 1515129421898448996 in Discord 1515101455525085337 now get Use Soundboard (and Use External Sounds) in main-server voice channel 1514128904783139018.

updates.title: Use separate Roblox groups for join requests and funds
updates.summary: Join-request whitelist sync now uses Clearwater Roleplay ERLC (163783791). -funds uses Clearwater-Whitelisted (140437562). The two IDs are no longer shared, even if the host env had them swapped.

updates.title: Log Roblox group join requests in Discord
updates.summary: Whitelist group join-request activity is posted to Discord channel 1536517651055120514 again. Accepts, declines, and waiting/skipped requests use a normal embed, and log send failures are no longer swallowed.

updates.title: Spin in-game weather every 20 minutes
updates.summary: The weather wheel now rolls every 20 minutes when notj3dah is not in-game (Clear 65%, rain 15%, fog 11%, thunderstorms 9%). Weather is still forced to clear while that player is in-game.

updates.title: Speak priority callouts at 1.15x
updates.summary: The LEO channel priority voice still uses Edge Guy, now at 1.15x speed instead of slow.

updates.title: Fix whitelisted Roblox group join requests
updates.summary: Group join requests from Discord members with the allowed whitelist roles are accepted again. If Discord’s member list is incomplete, unmatched requests are skipped instead of declined so whitelist players are not rejected by accident.

updates.title: Log every weather roll in Discord
updates.summary: Each 30-minute weather wheel result is posted to channel 1549178818814812211, including when weather stays the same, when notj3dah being in-game skips the wheel, and when weather is forced to clear.

updates.title: Restore the original priority voice
updates.summary: Priority callouts in the LEO voice channel use the original Edge Guy voice at a slow pace again, instead of Onyx or the robotic fallback voices.

updates.title: Stay in the LEO channel and speak after the beep
updates.summary: The bot no longer leaves the priority voice channel after the beep. It stays connected, retries TTS if Onyx fails, and then plays the spoken callout before disconnecting.

updates.title: Spin in-game weather every 30 minutes
updates.summary: When notj3dah is not in-game, the bot rolls server weather every 30 minutes (Clear 65%, rain 15%, fog 11%, thunderstorms 9%). If that player is in-game or joins, weather is forced to clear and the wheel does not run.

updates.title: Speak after the priority beep
updates.summary: After the LEO channel beep, the bot now plays the spoken priority line on the same voice connection. TTS starts immediately, OpenAI/Edge calls time out instead of hanging, and the player is stopped if the beep clip never goes idle so speech can still play.

updates.title: Join the LEO channel as soon as a priority starts
updates.summary: When a priority is approved, the bot now joins voice channel 1514128904783139018 right away and plays the beep plus spoken callout even if OpenAI TTS or the in-game command queue is slow.

updates.title: Use Onyx at 1.15 and the new radio beep for priority voice
updates.summary: Priority callouts in the LEO voice channel now play the 101-1-star radio beep, then speak with the Onyx voice at speed 1.15.

updates.title: Speed up the priority voice line and lengthen the beep
updates.summary: The LEO channel callout now uses a longer beep, then speaks at a normal pace: who started the priority, the vehicle description, and the priority type.

updates.title: End briefing on the first click
updates.summary: Clicking End briefing now disables the button right away and sends the ended :m only once. Layout unloads keep running in the background so the panel does not sit on the in-game command queue.

updates.title: Priority hint, /priority active, and Police car whitelist
updates.summary: When a priority starts, the bot now sends the in-game hint ":h The priority timer is active, please refrain from triggering any priorities at this time." instead of a :m. Anyone can use /priority active to see who has the current priority. Police can only drive the Falcon Advance XET, 2015 Bullhorn Prancer, 2021 Chevlon Camion, or 2024 FPIU; other cars get an in-game PM and a Discord DM listing those cars, repeating every 3 minutes until they switch.

updates.title: Change the priority voice beep
updates.summary: When a priority starts, the bot plays the new beep in the announce voice channel before the spoken callout.

updates.title: Check ER:LC Server Saved car presets
updates.summary: The bot looks at spawned ER:LC cars. If a Police, Sheriff, Fire, or DOT unit is driving without a Server Saved Preset loaded (Texture still Standard or a paint color), they get an in-game PM to load one.

updates.title: PM emergency drivers who are not on a server-saved vehicle preset
updates.summary: Police, Sheriff, Fire, and DOT players who stay in a spawned car with a stock or custom paint instead of a named server livery get an in-game PM asking them to use a server saved preset.

updates.title: Use custom post buttons and a V2 reply card
updates.summary: Internet posts send as a Components V2 card, not a classic embed. Photos sit on the right of the card. Like, repost, and reply use the custom emojis, and Send Post keeps the paper-plane emoji.

updates.title: Show profile pictures on posts and follow from ⋯
updates.summary: Internet posts now include the profile picture on the card. The ⋯ button opens a hidden Follow action. Followers get a ping when that account posts, then the ping is deleted.

updates.title: Allow extra Internet accounts, switching, and profile pictures
updates.summary: You can create more than one Internet account, switch which one posts and replies, and upload a profile picture for the selected account.

updates.title: Drop the extra name off Internet posts
updates.summary: Clearwater Internet posts now start with the profile card. They no longer show a separate product name above the post.

updates.title: Add Internet accounts and profile-style posts
updates.summary: The Internet Panel now has Create Account and Profile. Posts publish as profile cards with display name, @username, followers, and like/repost/reply/bookmark buttons.

updates.title: Fix -funds so balance, payouts, and sales are not smashed together
updates.summary: -funds now shows the group balance, last 7 payouts, and last 7 sales in separate Discord sections instead of one mashed line.

updates.title: Let admins run -funds with recent payouts and sales
updates.summary: -funds is Administrator-only and now shows the group balance plus the last 7 payouts sent and the last 7 sales from people buying group items.

updates.title: Point -funds at Roblox group 163783791
updates.summary: -funds now reads the treasury for Roblox group 163783791 by default. ROBLOX_COOKIE still has to be set on the bot host.

updates.title: Add -funds for Roblox group treasury
updates.summary: Ownership can run -funds to see this Roblox group’s Robux. Put the account cookie in ROBLOX_COOKIE on the bot host .env (never in Discord).

updates.title: Load briefing maps with the in-game layout name
updates.summary: /briefing now runs :loadlayout BREIFING WALLS and :loadlayout BREIFING ROAD BLOCKS, matching the saved map layout names.

updates.title: Use the in-game :loadlayout command for briefing maps
updates.summary: /briefing now loads and unloads map layouts with the in-game commands :loadlayout [Name] and :unloadlayout [Name], including BRIEFING WALLS and BRIEFING ROAD BLOCKS.

updates.title: Remove the 130 MPH GTA driving check
updates.summary: The bot no longer watches in-game speed or PMs people for going over 130 MPH. That GTA driving system is fully removed.

updates.title: Speak the priority in voice after the in-game callout
updates.summary: When a priority is approved, the bot now waits until the in-game :m callout is sent, then beeps and talks in voice: who started it, the priority type, and not to start any major roleplays.

updates.title: Fix briefing map layouts for walls and road blocks
updates.summary: /briefing now sends :loadlayout and :unloadlayout with quoted names so BRIEFING WALLS and BRIEFING ROAD BLOCKS actually load in-game, and the DM panel buttons still fire.

updates.title: List the requester on priorities and cap Priority Type
updates.summary: The person who submits a priority is always added as a participant. The old Priority Details field is now Priority Type and is limited to 25 characters on the form and the Discord card.

updates.title: Add /briefing for a server-wide LEO briefing
updates.summary: Administrators can run /briefing to drag Police and Sheriff into their voice channel, announce a briefing, start a 20 minute peace timer, load BRIEFING WALLS, and DM a panel to load BRIEFING ROAD BLOCKS or end the briefing.

updates.title: Only scare-ping two overdue mod calls
updates.summary: The moderating ping now waits until at least two unpicked mod calls have both sat more than 2 minutes. When the queue is cleared, the same channel gets Thank you, for picking up the mod calls.

updates.title: Cap priorities at 4 people and 2 cars
updates.summary: A priority request can list at most 4 participants and 2 cars. The form says so, and submitting more is rejected.

updates.title: Warn civilians who kill during an active priority
updates.summary: If a civilian who is not listed on the running priority kills someone, they get an in-game :pm and a Discord DM telling them there is an active Priority and not to kill anyone.

updates.title: Make priority buttons respond immediately
updates.summary: Approve, Deny, Void, and extra time now update the Discord card first. In-game :prty / :pt / :m commands keep running in the background so clicks are not stuck on the 5-second ER:LC command queue.

updates.title: Rewrite the priority card to Ended
updates.summary: When a priority timer ends or everyone listed dies, the original Active card is updated to Priority Request — Ended, with the Void and Started buttons replaced by Ended.

updates.title: Keep priority requests across bot restarts
updates.summary: Pending and active priorities save to host data, including who already died. After a restart the bot keeps watching the timer and still ends the priority if everyone listed is down.

updates.title: Let role 1515107822432419971 approve extra time
updates.summary: Extra time Approve and Deny can be used by Clearwater staff or by members with role 1515107822432419971.

updates.title: Stop priority Approve from acting like Deny
updates.summary: Approve and Deny are on separate rows with unique button ids so Discord no longer treats every click as Deny. Extra-time Approve time is split the same way.

updates.title: Fix priority approve buttons, extra time, and voice
updates.summary: Approve, deny, and extra-time buttons now update the card you clicked. Anyone can approve extra time and that extends the in-game :prty timer. The start chime is softer and the voice announcement speaks more slowly.

updates.title: Let anyone approve priorities and announce them in-game
updates.summary: Anyone can approve or deny a priority request. New requests ping role 1515107822432419971. When one starts, the bot beeps and speaks it in voice channel 1514128904783139018 and sends an in-game :m not to start any major roleplays.

updates.title: Ignore commands in the Florida Highway Patrol server
updates.summary: The bot no longer runs or replies to slash commands or prefix commands in server 1513609541483499790.

updates.title: Remove Florida Operations profile and welcome
updates.summary: The bot no longer uses a per-server name, logo, or banner in server 1513609541483499790, and it no longer posts a Florida Highway Patrol welcome when someone joins that server. A restart clears the leftover profile.

updates.title: Welcome new Florida Highway Patrol members
updates.summary: When someone joins server 1513609541483499790, the bot posts a Florida Highway Patrol welcome in channel 1513609542007521528 that pings them and shows the current member count.

updates.title: Set Florida Operations per-server bot profile
updates.summary: In server 1513609541483499790 the bot now uses the name Florida Operations with the provided logo and banner on that server only.

updates.title: Exempt role 1514033321024426154 from team balance and the VC gate
updates.summary: Members with role 1514033321024426154 are skipped by Sheriff team balance and VC checks, and they can pass the secondary-server VC gate with that role alone.

updates.title: Limit each PCSO ticket category to one staff role
updates.summary: General Support tickets are visible only to General Support, OPC tickets only to IA, and Office of the Sheriff tickets only to Command Staff. A bot restart rewrites those category permissions and every open ticket channel.

updates.title: Grant Command Staff, IA, and General Support on every ticket
updates.summary: Every PCSO ticket now hides inherited category roles and is visible only to the opener, the bot, Command Staff, IA, and General Support. Those three roles can also claim and close any ticket, and a restart still rewrites current ticket permissions.

updates.title: Restore the full Discord bot
updates.summary: Bring back slash commands, prefix commands, and automations from before the empty-bot wipe. Ticket view roles stay limited to Command Staff, IA, and General Support, and a restart still resyncs open ticket permissions.

updates.title: Resync ticket permissions on bot restart
updates.summary: Restarting the bot now rewrites view permissions on every open PCSO ticket. It retries after the Discord cache settles so existing tickets pick up Command Staff, IA, and General Support access.

updates.title: Limit ticket visibility to Command Staff, IA, and General Support
updates.summary: Open PCSO tickets now hide inherited category roles. Only the opener, the bot, and the matching staff role can see them: General Support for general tickets, IA for OPC, and Command Staff for Office of the Sheriff. Claim and close use the same roles or Administrator.

updates.title: Clear the Discord bot for a rebuild
updates.summary: The host bot now only logs into Discord. Slash commands, prefix commands, and all automations (VC checks, Sheriff balance, ER:LC, PCSO panels, Internet, and the rest) are removed so a new bot can be built.

updates.title: Raise the Sheriff team cap to 27
updates.summary: Sheriff team balance now allows 27 players. The 27th join is allowed; extras over that are still wanted or rotated with the 10-minute leave warning.

updates.title: Remove PCSO stationary AFK alerts
updates.summary: Pinellas Operations no longer posts 10-minute and 15-minute warnings when a deputy stays still in ER:LC while on shift.

updates.title: Keep Discord Check on a live in-game roster
updates.summary: -dc no longer shows a frozen player list while VC checks are sending PMs and jails. The in-game roster keeps refreshing in the background, and Discord Check waits for a snapshot that is at most 8 seconds old.

updates.title: Keep civilian CAD forms off PCSO weekly reports
updates.summary: Weekly personnel PDFs no longer list Vehicle Registration or other civilian CAD forms. Only Pinellas arrest, citation, MVA, OIS, and warrant reports count.

updates.title: Jail after every not-in-Discord PM
updates.summary: Players missing Discord get a comms PM every minute, and each of those PMs is followed by a jail once they are on a team.

updates.title: Mirror main-server unbans to every bot server
updates.summary: When someone is unbanned from the main Clearwater Discord, the bot also unbans them in every other server it is in. Bans are not copied.

updates.title: Let the designated role claim any ticket
updates.summary: Members with role 1514363218754142218 can claim General, OPC, and Office of the Sheriff tickets even without Manage Messages. New tickets also grant that role access so they can open any of them.

updates.title: Post CAD warrant logs to the warrant channel
updates.summary: When a PCSO unit files a warrant in Melonly CAD, it now posts to the warrant channel with the same report embed and PDF as the other CAD logs, instead of being treated as an arrest.

updates.title: Fix busy weekly PDF downloads
updates.summary: Download PDF on the admin panel now builds from the personnel row already on screen instead of asking Melonly again, so it no longer fails with a 60-second busy message after the roster loads.

updates.title: Fix How can we help card icons
updates.summary: The Contact, report, and member resource icons no longer sit in a clipped gray square. They show at full size with no background.

updates.title: Alert on mass in-game command abuse
updates.summary: If someone uses :heal all, :bring all / :bing all, :bring others, :kick all, or :ban all, the bot posts an @here alert in the command-abuse channel. It does not undo the command.

updates.title: Ping staff when a mod call sits for 3 minutes
updates.summary: If an in-game mod call is not picked up within 3 minutes, the bot posts one scare ping in the staff channel telling that role to pick up calls or be auto-infracted in 1 minute. Nobody is actually auto-infracted.

updates.title: Bring back GTA driving checks
updates.summary: The bot again watches in-game speed over 130. Two snapshots in a row get an in-game PM to slow down, and a second PM if they speed again within 3 minutes. Players are not loaded, kicked, or jailed for this.

updates.title: Give Sheriff rotations a 10 minute leave warning
updates.summary: When someone joins Sheriff over the 23-player cap and a player has been on the team over 1.5 hours, that player is PMed to leave in 10 minutes (with a 5-minute reminder) instead of being wanted immediately. They are wanted only after that window if the team is still over the cap.

updates.title: Put Office of the Sheriff tickets in their own category
updates.summary: Office of the Sheriff tickets now open in Discord category 1514848142653390898 instead of sharing the Office of Professional Compliance category.

updates.title: Jail players not in Discord after one minute
updates.summary: VC checks still rotate the old PMs and add the new cwrpvc / join-voice lines. Anyone not in Discord is reminded every minute, jailed after one minute, and jailed again every minute if they get out while still missing Discord.

updates.title: VC checks default on
updates.summary: Automatic VC checks now start on after every bot restart. Use /vc checks off to turn them off.

updates.title: Keep the PCSO ER:LC key off the main server key
updates.summary: ERLC_SERVER_KEY stays the main ER:LC server. PCSO training reports use only PCSOERLCAPI_KEY for the PCSO server.

updates.title: Fix Log out from the admin panel
updates.summary: Clicking Log out no longer shows Method not allowed. GET /api/auth/logout clears the Discord session cookie and returns to the homepage.

updates.title: PCSOERLCAPI uses the ER:LC server key
updates.summary: Training report approve/deny calls PCSOERLCAPI with the same ER:LC private-server key (server-key header). It reuses ERLC_SERVER_KEY unless PCSOERLCAPI_KEY is set to that same kind of key.

updates.title: Open the employee panel for everyone signed in
updates.summary: The site now has an Employee hub with Training Division, Department, Reports Admin, Command Staff, and Admin. Anyone signed in can start or join SRT/TEU/patrol training, take the website quiz, and see instructor scores. Training reports can be approved or denied and are sent to PCSOERLCAPI. Role ID locks will be added later.

updates.title: Stop treating every ER:LC call as a 5s command limit
updates.summary: PRC rate-limits this bot host by IP and POST /command at 1 per 5 seconds. Player-list reads no longer start that 5s gap, and hour-long 429 Retry-After values are waited out so the host is not IP-blocked again. Another bot on a different host can still work while this IP is blocked.

updates.title: Remove Patrol Staff from Divisions
updates.summary: The Divisions dropdown no longer lists Patrol Staff. Other division pages stay in the menu.

updates.title: Stop Contact ticket replies from timing out
updates.summary: Website ticket replies no longer scan the whole Discord server first. Mentions like <@user> post in Discord, and a slow bot host shows a retry message instead of The operation was aborted due to timeout.

updates.title: Show how long the ER:LC rate limit lasts
updates.summary: -ratelimit now shows Limited for (remaining seconds) and Cleared as a Discord timestamp so you can see exactly when the PRC cooldown ends.

updates.title: Ping @here when a support ticket opens
updates.summary: Every new PCSO support ticket pings @here in the ticket channel so staff online in that category are notified. Reopening an existing ticket does not ping again.

updates.title: Sync new ticket channels to their category permissions
updates.summary: New PCSO support tickets copy the category permission overwrites, then add the opener and bot on top, so staff roles on the category can see every new ticket.

updates.title: Add admin-only -ratelimit
updates.summary: Administrators can run -ratelimit to see whether the ER:LC API is ready, cooling down, or blocked, plus the queue and cached roster.

updates.title: Cap bogus ER:LC retry-after so -dc is not blocked for hours
updates.summary: PRC Retry-After values like 4857 seconds are capped at 15 seconds. -dc waits that short cooldown and retries instead of telling you to come back in hours.

updates.title: Tell -dc when ER:LC is rate-limited instead of saying busy
updates.summary: -dc waits for the ER:LC cooldown instead of giving up at 12 seconds with a busy message. If the API is rate-limited or unreachable, it says so. Sheriff and zone loops stay off until a snapshot succeeds.

updates.title: Stop ER:LC retries from freezing Discord commands
updates.summary: Sheriff and VC no longer stampede a new or rate-limited ER:LC key. A bad key fails once and stays failed, 429s leave the queue instead of retrying for half a minute, and -dc replies Fetching Discord Check instead of typing forever.

updates.title: Make -dc load the player list instead of saying busy
updates.summary: -dc no longer gives up after 8 seconds while Sheriff commands hold the ER:LC line. With an empty cache it fetches the roster instead of waiting, so Discord Check can send after a new API key.

updates.title: Stop slash and -dc commands from hanging on ER:LC
updates.summary: /request-priority now opens or replies within Discord's 3 second limit instead of waiting on the ER:LC queue. -dc times out with an error instead of typing forever, and a bad or expired ERLC_SERVER_KEY is reported immediately.

updates.title: Remove dispatch radio listen, talk, and talk logs
updates.summary: The bot no longer joins Dispatch to log who is talking on radio. The admin panel Listen Live and Hold to Talk controls are removed.

updates.title: Stop the bot host from refusing to start
updates.summary: start.sh no longer exits because vercel.json is in this repo. Slash command registration failures no longer block login, so -dc and other prefix commands still come up after a restart.

updates.title: Point How can we help cards to website pages
updates.summary: The homepage Contact, Submit a report, and Member resources cards now open Contact, File a Police Report, and Careers on this website. Their icons are sized to the card and use the police-report and sheriff-star artwork.

updates.title: Show ticket transcripts on the PCSO website
updates.summary: Closing a Discord ticket now stores the official transcript on Contact. Signed-in openers can read the saved conversation and open the full Cookie transcript from the website after the channel is deleted.

updates.title: Sync PCSO Discord tickets with the website
updates.summary: Contact tickets now follow the live Discord support channels for each signed-in member, including tickets opened in Discord. Website replies still post as you. If a ticket channel is deleted, the website marks that ticket closed.

updates.title: Fix Discord login on the PCSO website
updates.summary: The header Log In button now updates after Discord OAuth because the nav is built first. Members of the PCSO Discord server can stay signed in on the website even without the Clearwater tester role.

updates.title: Make PCSO nav dropdown links clickable
updates.summary: Dropdown menus no longer sit in a hover gap under the header, so About, Law Enforcement, Divisions, and Contact links can be clicked through to their pages.

updates.title: Dropdown arrows on PCSO top nav
updates.summary: About, Law Enforcement, Divisions, and Contact now show a down arrow. The arrow flips up when that menu is open.

updates.title: New PCSO site navigation, tickets, and careers
updates.summary: The top bar is now Home, About, Law Enforcement, Divisions, Contact, and a boxed Careers button. About, Law Enforcement, Divisions, and Contact use hover menus. Contact opens Discord tickets from the same questions and posts website replies through a webhook as the signed-in user, plus public records status. Careers includes Apply Now with the official application questions and pending/approved/denied status.

updates.title: Office of Professional Compliance ticket questions
updates.summary: Opening an Office of Professional Compliance ticket now asks only: who you are reporting, why you are reporting that deputy, and whether you have proof.

updates.title: Count Melonly CAD reports on weekly deputy PDFs
updates.summary: Weekly personnel reports now page through Melonly CAD records for the last 7 days and match the deputy the same way live CAD imports do, including nested createdBy Discord ids. Deputies who filed several reports should no longer show 0.

updates.title: Remove ticket Staff Panel and add -cr close request
updates.summary: PCSO support tickets no longer have a Staff Panel button. Staff can use -cr in a ticket to send a Yes/No close request; if the ticket opener clicks Yes, the ticket closes.

updates.title: Stop PCSO site forms from writing JSON on Vercel
updates.summary: Police reports, Crime Stoppers tips, complaints, and public records no longer try to save JSON on Vercel’s read-only filesystem. The site forwards the form to the bot host, which stores it and posts it to Discord.

updates.title: Match weekly personnel PDFs to the official CAD report layout
updates.summary: Admin weekly personnel downloads now use the same Pinellas official-record PDF as Melonly CAD reports: sheriff star, header bars, labeled field rows, and the operations disclaimer.

updates.title: PCSO jail roster, reports, Crime Stoppers, and Inside the Star
updates.summary: Jail Information lists Roblox username and time in jail only. Police reports use a form plus the in-game Liberty County map and post to Discord. Crime Stoppers is an anonymous text tip. Impound Release is removed. Inside the Star is admin-managed photos, videos, and text. Public records requests can be accepted or denied in Discord with a DM of the report/key or a complaint link. Complaints collect trooper name, badge, in-game location, reason, description, and witnesses. How can we help cards use the original layout.

updates.title: Let the PCSO supervisor role infract and edit infractions
updates.summary: Role 1514851283817725962 can use /infract and /edit-infraction. Those commands are no longer hidden behind Manage Roles; the bot still checks the PCSO infraction roles before anyone can issue or edit a record.

updates.title: Stop jailing people -dc already shows in voice
updates.summary: If someone is in a Clearwater Discord voice channel, VC checks treat them as in VC the same way -dc does, including matches from live voice states. A failed unjail is retried instead of leaving them in jail.

updates.title: Replace Active Calls with File a Police Report and Crime Stoppers
updates.summary: The homepage no longer has Active Calls. That slot is File a Police Report. Submit Tip is now Crime Stoppers, with anonymous reporting copy and a reward of up to $3,000. Old /active-calls and /submit-tip links redirect.

updates.title: Stop jailing people whose Discord nick is their Roblox user
updates.summary: If a Discord nickname is the Roblox username or contains it, VC checks treat them as in Discord. Unmatched players are only PMed, never jailed as missing. Jail is only for people found in Discord who stay out of voice for 5 minutes.

updates.title: VC checks jail and PM, never kick
updates.summary: Missing Discord or voice is handled with in-game PMs and jail only. The bot never :kick or :load for VC checks. GTA driving checks stay removed.

updates.title: Stop stale mod-call voice drags
updates.summary: The bot no longer moves people into a mod-scene VC after a staff pickup if the caller already left the game or the call is more than 2 minutes old. Live pickups still move both people if they are in Discord voice.

updates.title: Stop jailing people whose nick is their Roblox name
updates.summary: A partial Discord member list is no longer treated as proof someone is missing. Automatic :jail and :load are blocked. Nickname matching still counts a Discord nick that is the Roblox username, including display names.

updates.title: Fix priority vehicle search
updates.summary: /request-priority vehicle dropdown is now a required single pick with a None option so Discord shows type-to-search. Owner names are in the option label so typing a username filters the list.

updates.title: VC checks default off
updates.summary: Automatic VC checks now start off after every bot restart. Use /vc checks on to turn them back on.

updates.title: Remove priority Join Queue and queue DMs
updates.summary: The Join Queue panel, -prtyq, in-game :mod grants, and Melonly/boost DMs for people sitting in the ER:LC queue are removed. /request-priority is unchanged.

updates.title: Remove GTA driving checks
updates.summary: The bot no longer watches in-game speed or sends GTA speeding PMs. That system is fully removed.

updates.title: Restore PCSO infractions when void is false
updates.summary: /edit-infraction void:false now un-voids the record and removes strikethrough from the posted PCSO infraction message. void:true still voids and strikes it out. Leaving void unset does not change void status.

updates.title: Stop automatic jail and load
updates.summary: VC checks only send in-game PMs now and unjail anyone they previously jailed. Automatic :load is blocked. An incomplete Discord member list is no longer treated as players missing from Discord.

updates.title: Lock /vc whitelist to Discord Administrator
updates.summary: /vc whitelist is hidden from members without Discord Administrator permission and is rejected at runtime unless they have that permission in the Clearwater server.

updates.title: GTA speeding no longer loads players
updates.summary: Going over 130 still gets an in-game PM, including a second PM if it happens again within 3 minutes. The bot no longer sends :load.

updates.title: VC whitelist slash command
updates.summary: Administrators can run /vc whitelist to stop VC checks from jailing or PMing a Discord member or in-game Roblox username. action:remove takes them off; action:list shows the list.

updates.title: Stop false GTA loads and hashed PMs
updates.summary: A single map rubberband no longer counts as GTA speeding, so players in Discord/VC are not :load'ed by a lag jump. In-game PMs were rewritten so Roblox does not replace them with #.

updates.title: VC checks jail instead of kicking
updates.summary: Players missing Discord or voice are PMed in-game and jailed. VC checks never :kick, :load, or :wanted them off the private server.

updates.title: ER:LC checks stay instant on the 5s line
updates.summary: Sheriff, VC, GTA, and other player-list checks reuse the last ER:LC roster instead of waiting behind each other. Only in-game commands wait the PRC 5 second gap, and roster refreshes run when that line is idle.

updates.title: Listen to Dispatch RTO on the website
updates.summary: Added a Listen Live / Stop Listening control to admin radio logs, with protected live audio from the existing Discord radio connection.

updates.title: Remove the old Owner panel
updates.summary: Removed the unused Owner panel and its configuration endpoint. Old Owner page links return to the homepage.

updates.title: Radio talk logs show latest 10
updates.summary: Admin dispatch radio talk logs now show the latest 10 transmits and auto-refresh every 3 seconds.

updates.title: Fix Active Calls Melonly configuration
updates.summary: Active Calls now loads PCSO Melonly CAD data through the bot host bridge (BOT_API_URL), so the page works when Melonly is configured on the bot even if Vercel has no MELONLY_API_KEY.

updates.title: Detect radio key-ups over voice websocket
updates.summary: Dispatch radio talk logging now listens for Discord voice Speaking packets on the websocket, not only UDP audio events, so transmits are recorded even when the bot host cannot receive voice UDP.

updates.title: Log all dispatch radio transmits
updates.summary: Dispatch radio talk logs now record every non-bot key-up in the radio VC. Unit/member columns parse Clearwater nicknames as callsign | roblox username.

updates.title: Fix empty dispatch radio talk logs
updates.summary: Admin radio logs no longer silently show empty when the website cannot reach the bot. Reused radio VC connections now rebind talk listeners, and the admin panel surfaces bot bridge/monitor status.

updates.title: Gray Discord link embed color
updates.summary: Discord link previews for the PCSO site now use a gray theme-color accent instead of blue.

updates.title: Block non-admins from the admin panel
updates.summary: Signed-in users without admin access are redirected away from /admin instead of staying on the page with the panel merely hidden.

updates.title: News and events image uploads
updates.summary: Admin news and event forms now accept an uploaded image (or an image URL). Event images show on the homepage upcoming list and Events page; news images continue on the homepage carousel and News page.

updates.title: Stabilize PCSO radio VC logging
updates.summary: Stopped the dispatch radio monitor from destroying and recreating its voice connection on a loop, and skipped rejoins when already connected so talk logs can stay online for the admin panel.

updates.title: PCSO sign-in gray and black theme
updates.summary: Restyled the Discord sign-in page to the site gray/black theme, replacing the blue glow, checkbox, and Discord button accents.

updates.title: PCSO sign-in branding and OAuth redirect fix
updates.summary: The Discord sign-in page now uses PCSO branding, and OAuth redirect_uri is derived from the request host so login matches the Discord app redirect URL for that domain.

updates.title: Stay under Vercel Hobby serverless limit
updates.summary: PCSO and bot API routes now share dynamic handlers so production deploys stay within the Hobby plan's 12 serverless function limit.

updates.title: Radio logging yields for Frequency Change greetings
updates.summary: While the bot is parked in the dispatch radio VC for transmit logging, it may leave briefly to speak Frequency Change greetings, then return to radio monitoring.

updates.title: PCSO application submit text limit
updates.summary: Entry application review posts now keep Components V2 displayable text under Discord's 4000-character limit by showing a capped preview and attaching the full answers as a text file.

updates.title: PCSO AFK alert timings
updates.summary: AFK stationarity alerts now fire at 10 minutes for the first warning and 15 minutes for the second warning.

updates.title: PCSO radio talk logging
updates.summary: The bot now stays in the PCSO dispatch radio voice channel, logs when a PCSO unit transmits and for how long, and shows those talk logs on the admin panel.

updates.title: PCSO quick-links dark theme
updates.summary: Restyled the homepage quick-links bar to the site gray/black theme with matching gray accent lines on top and bottom.

updates.title: PCSO quick-links brand colors
updates.summary: Restyled the homepage quick-links bar to PCSO navy and red branding, and added a matching accent line above the bar.

updates.title: PCSO quick links + Melonly active calls
updates.summary: Added the PCSO quick-links bar under the homepage hero (without Obtain Fingerprints), linked each item to its own page, and wired Active Calls to Melonly CAD calls that have a PCSO unit assigned.

updates.title: PCSO roster cleanup checks
updates.summary: The PCSO roster now checks member rank roles every minute, removes assignments when a member no longer has the recorded rank, and expires warning or strike history after four days.

updates.title: PCSO callsigns update the live roster
updates.summary: The -callsign roster workflow now reads and writes the PCSO databaseâ€™s actual rank, callsign, roleplay name, Discord ID, activity, and punishment columns, using the shared operations database.

updates.title: PCSO four-day inactivity tracking
updates.summary: The PCSO roster now marks members Inactive when their latest Pinellas Melonly shift is more than four days old, then returns automatically marked members to Active after a new shift while preserving Activity Exempt, LOA, and suspension priority.

updates.title: PCSO infractions use one record channel
updates.summary: Permanent PCSO infraction embeds now always post in the designated infractions channel instead of the channel where staff opened the panel.

updates.title: PCSO application reviewer role access
updates.summary: Members with the designated PCSO employee role can now approve or deny entry applications even when they do not have Administrator or Manage Roles permissions.

updates.title: PCSO callsign and roster sync
updates.summary: Added the Administrator-only -callsign panel for assigning rank-based callsigns, updating PCSO roster records and nicknames, and synchronizing Melonly LOA, suspension, and infraction status every two minutes without overwriting Appointment / Notes.

updates.title: Pinellas welcome emoji and apply banners
updates.summary: Updated the Pinellas welcome wave emoji and replaced the PCSO application panel top/bottom banners with the new APPLICATION artwork.

updates.title: Updated the Pinellas flag banner
updates.summary: Changed the bot's server-specific banner in the Pinellas County Sheriff's Office server to the supplied black-and-white PCSO flag image.

updates.title: Restored the Pinellas bot banner
updates.summary: Restored the supplied PCSO operations image as the bot's server-specific banner in the Pinellas County Sheriff's Office server while keeping the sheriff badge avatar.

updates.title: Applications work without optional artwork
updates.summary: The Pinellas application panel now posts its text and buttons even when the banner or footer image is missing from an Apollo upload.

updates.title: Updated the Pinellas bot avatar
updates.summary: Changed the bot's server-specific avatar in the Pinellas County Sheriff's Office server to the supplied black-and-white sheriff badge image.

updates.title: Boot loaders no longer depend on helper files
updates.summary: Moved slash, prefix, event, and registration loaders into bot.js so incomplete Apollo uploads do not crash on one missing loader helper after another.

updates.title: Ready services start normally
updates.summary: Fixed the Discord presence call that stopped the ready handler before the secondary gate, ER:LC zone voice, status channels, frequency greeting, notice channel, and Internet panel could start.

updates.title: Bot boots without the command-loader helper
updates.summary: Moved the slash-command loading logic into bot.js so an Apollo upload missing utils/loadCommands.js no longer crashes immediately after the boot message.

updates.title: Zip-upload boot without host sync
updates.summary: index.js now only starts bot.js and no longer imports hostCodeSync, so Apollo zip uploads without .git or sync helpers can boot.

updates.title: Boot works without git on Apollo
updates.summary: Host sync is skipped when .git is missing, credit-store packs are inlined into internetStore, and an emergency no-git console fix script can repair a broken zip-upload host.

updates.title: Self-heal missing credit-store on boot
updates.summary: Hosts without .git were crashing because lib/credit-store.js could not be restored. Boot now writes the missing credit-store files automatically, and pack data also lives under utils/creditStore.js.

updates.title: Host sync runs before bot imports
updates.summary: Fixed Apollo boot crashes when a tracked file like lib/credit-store.js was missing: index.js now force-syncs from main before loading Discord/bot modules, so the missing file can be restored.

updates.title: Pinellas welcome message with member count
updates.summary: Pinellas join welcomes now use the PCSO branding copy, a disabled member-count button, and an Information link button to the info channel.

updates.title: PCSO entry applications and clear status
updates.summary: Removed the Watching Clearwater Roleplay status. Added -apply (Administrator) to post the PCSO Components V2 entry panel, DM question flow, and staff approve/deny review with role assignment. Updated the Pinellas per-server avatar/banner branding.

updates.title: Animated Pinellas Operations avatar
updates.summary: The Pinellas per-server bot avatar is now an animated GIF of the sheriff badge with a subtle shine and glow loop.

updates.title: Pinellas Operations banner and bio
updates.summary: The Pinellas per-server bot profile now sets a PCSO collage banner and the Pinellas County Sheriff's Office operations bio, in addition to the nickname and badge avatar.

updates.title: Pinellas server logo refreshed (transparent)
updates.summary: Replaced the Pinellas Operations per-server avatar with the new five-point sheriff star badge on a transparent background.

updates.title: Pinellas Operations nickname, logo, and welcome
updates.summary: In the Pinellas County Sheriff's Office Discord, the bot sets its per-server nickname to Pinellas Operations and uses the PCSO badge as its server avatar. New joins get a welcome ping in the configured channel with a link to applications.

updates.title: Pause Roblox group sync when API account is moderated
updates.summary: When Roblox returns 403 User is moderated for the Open Cloud API key, group sync now posts one clear pause notice and waits 6 hours instead of spamming the log channel every minute. Fix by unmoderating that Roblox account or creating a new API key on an unmoderated account.

updates.title: Frequency Change greeting skips bot drags
updates.summary: If a bot (including Clearwater zone drag or another bot) moves someone into a Frequency Change VC, the bot no longer joins to play the welcome TTS. Manual joins by players still get the greeting when they are first in the channel.

updates.title: Clearer Spark/Apollo host repair steps
updates.summary: Added a noisy one-line Apollo console repair command and louder [host-sync] boot logs so stuck hosts show whether .git exists, fetch worked, and which commit is running. Still preserves data/ and .env.

updates.title: Spark/Apollo host sync keeps git login
updates.summary: Host code sync no longer replaces Apollo’s private-repo git remote with a public URL (which made fetch fail and kept old code). It preserves the panel token, force-syncs main, refreshes npm deps after updates, and leaves data/ + .env alone. Startup command can stay locked.

updates.title: Works with locked Apollopanel startup
updates.summary: You no longer need to change the panel startup command. index.js force-syncs code from main on boot while preserving data/ and .env, then restarts onto the new commit if needed. Do not wipe-and-reupload to update — just Restart (one-time console reset if still stuck on old code).

updates.title: Restart updates code without wiping data
updates.summary: start.sh now force-syncs bot code from main while preserving host-only data/ and .env. Do not delete-all and re-upload a zip to update — that wipes Clearwater Internet, salaries, and identity cache. Use Restart with bash start.sh.

updates.title: ER:LC zone voice logs to Discord
updates.summary: ER:LC map zone voice now posts enter/skip/error/heartbeat logs to channel 1514547037537046688 so staff can see whether the drag is running and why moves are skipped.

updates.title: ER:LC zone voice polls every 7s
updates.summary: The ER:LC map zone voice drag checker now polls player positions every 7 seconds instead of 10.

updates.title: ER:LC map zone voice drag
updates.summary: Players who enter the marked grassy map zone are moved into voice channel 1545525189339774997. Leaving the zone does nothing. Zone bounds are inset from surrounding roads.

updates.title: Secondary gate allowlist expanded
updates.summary: Main-server role 1536839307766267944 is now allowed through the secondary server gate.

updates.title: Locked post auto-deletes messages
updates.summary: Any message sent in Discord post/channel 1545828641999560824 is automatically deleted.

updates.title: Secondary gate uses REST role checks
updates.summary: Secondary server gate now verifies required main-server roles through Discord REST (not role cache), and the periodic mass sweep is disabled. Only confirmed missing-role members are kicked on join.

updates.title: Secondary gate no longer false-kicks
updates.summary: The secondary server gate now force-checks roles on the main Clearwater server and will not kick someone if role lookup fails. Only members confirmed missing roles 1514421440890409060 / 1514744040778760252 are removed from 1514189396184793169.

updates.title: Discord update log disabled
updates.summary: The bot no longer posts update announcements to a Discord channel, which removes the Unknown Channel error on startup.

updates.title: Host startup force-sync
updates.summary: Added start.sh so Apollopanel can force-reset to main before launch. This fixes the stuck old bot caused by a dirty downloads/rebuild-exe.sh blocking git pull.

updates.title: Secondary server role gate
updates.summary: Joining server 1514189396184793169 now requires role 1514744040778760252 or 1514421440890409060 in the main Clearwater Discord. Members without those roles are kicked, including a sweep of people already in that server.

updates.title: Update log channel moved
updates.summary: Bot update announcements now post to channel 1514547037537046688 (same channel as Hold VC action logs).

updates.title: Website removed — Discord bot only
updates.summary: The repository is now Discord-bot only. Website, Vercel, Phone, and the old HTTP bridge were removed. Hold VC action logs always post to channel 1514547037537046688.

updates.title: Clearwater Internet removed from website
updates.summary: The website no longer includes Clearwater Internet. Use Discord for community posts. Home, Departments, Docs, and Server Management stay on the site.

updates.title: Hold VC mutes faster
updates.summary: `-holdvc` now starts server-muting members as soon as the announcement begins and processes hold VC mutes/unmutes in parallel, so large voice chats lock and release much faster.

updates.title: Hold VC unmutes on channel move
updates.summary: `-holdvc` still server-mutes members who join the held voice channel, and now explicitly unserver-mutes them as soon as they leave that held channel or move into another voice channel.

updates.title: Cleaner Internet settings
updates.summary: The Discord Internet Settings card no longer shows empty Pronouns or Location rows.

updates.title: Internet post deletion permissions
updates.summary: Only a post's author or a Discord Administrator can use its Delete button. Deleting a forum post now removes the complete thread and its comments from the Internet channel.

updates.title: Discord Internet uploads and moderation
updates.summary: Clearwater Internet posts now accept image and GIF uploads from Discord, use the new Heart and chat emojis, and no longer show a report button. Automod holds go to a Discord staff review queue, and staff can use /internet panel to warn, mute, ban, or clear restrictions while affected users receive a DM.

updates.title: Clearwater Internet moves to Discord
updates.summary: The new Internet Panel in Discord lets members publish forum posts, like and comment, view profiles, report or delete posts, edit profile settings, and manage notification preferences without using the website.

updates.title: Motion on Home, Docs, and Wallet
updates.summary: Home, Departments, Docs, and Wallet now use Animate UI motion for titles, numbers, buttons, and scroll progress, still on the existing dark Clearwater look.

updates.title: Department weekly salaries
updates.summary: Ownership can configure department Discord servers, paid roles, and weekly Clearwater Credits payouts on a dedicated Owner panel Salaries tab. Eligible members see their stacked weekly pay on the Wallet Salary tab. Each department can pay different amounts per Discord role, and payouts also DM a wallet update.

updates.title: Discord emojis on Clearwater Internet
updates.summary: The emoji picker on Clearwater Internet now includes your Discord server's custom emojis. You can add them to posts and DMs, and they show as images in the feed.

updates.title: Hold VC mutes people who join
updates.summary: While `-holdvc` is active, anyone who joins the held voice channel is server-muted (Ownership skipped). Leaving the channel unmutes them again.

updates.title: Ownership can grant developer badge
updates.summary: Ownership can give or remove the Developer badge from the staff user panel. That badge unlocks full website permissions.

updates.title: Developer badge unlocks full site access
updates.summary: Accounts with the Developer badge now get every website permission: Owner Panel, staff tools, Server Management, and government access.

updates.title: Developer badge assigned
updates.summary: Added the Developer badge for Discord user 848356730256883744 on Clearwater Internet.

updates.title: Business logo URL preview fixed
updates.summary: Logo image URL now converts freeimage.host and Imgur page links into direct image links, shows a clear error when a link is not an image, and allows iili.io / Imgur images through the site security policy.

updates.title: Owner Panel only for owners
updates.summary: Owner Panel no longer uses the broken hidden attribute on the homepage menu. It stays invisible unless you are Ownership, then shows with a proper visibility class.

updates.title: GIF search fixed
updates.summary: Clearwater Internet GIF search works again. The Giphy endpoint was missing a cache helper import and failed every search.

updates.title: Hold VC is a prefix command again
updates.summary: Ownership hold VC is back on the dash prefix: `-holdvc` and `-unholdvc` (slash `/holdvc` / `/unholdvc` removed).

updates.title: Phone launcher uses setup and the Clearwater logo
updates.summary: Opening Clearwater Phone now always starts with Discord, Z Phone or X Phone, wallpaper, and settings. The launcher uses the Clearwater logo instead of the old anchor mark.

updates.title: Phone setup, maps, and home bar
updates.summary: First launch now requires Discord, then Z Phone (Samsung) or X Phone (Apple), wallpaper colors that actually tint the home screen, and the same startup and shortcut settings as Settings. Maps no longer shows extra road lines or a squished county map. The bottom bar closes the current app, and Find My pans and zooms like Maps.

updates.title: Phone first-launch customize
updates.summary: Opening Clearwater Phone for the first time now goes Sign in → pick Z Phone (Samsung) or X Phone (Apple) → choose a wallpaper color, then launches.

updates.title: Phone installs as a Windows app
updates.summary: Download Phone now installs Clearwater Phone like a normal Windows app (Start Menu and desktop shortcut). After setup you can delete the downloaded installer. Quit the old tray app first if Windows will not let you delete the previous .exe.

updates.title: Bigger Find My map
updates.summary: The Find My map in Clearwater Phone now fills most of the screen instead of a small preview.

updates.title: Maps reroutes and Find My search
updates.summary: Phone Maps recalculates the road path if you go off route. Find My now has a name search and Discord profile pictures on the list and map.

updates.title: Phone Messages matches Internet
updates.summary: Inside Phone Internet, Wallet and Messages are hidden because those are their own Phone apps. The Messages app now opens the same inbox as the website Messages tab.

updates.title: Edit business profile only for managers
updates.summary: The Edit business profile button no longer shows on every member page. It only appears on a business account you actually manage.

updates.title: Phone Maps follows roads
updates.summary: Start route now navigates along painted Liberty County roads. Management can draw those roads on Server Management, Phone Maps zooms like Google Maps, and your in-game pin updates about every two seconds.

updates.title: Phone home tagline removed
updates.summary: The Clearwater Phone home screen no longer shows the Internet / Roleplay Panel line under the logo.

updates.title: Phone Internet is the real mobile site
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone now opens the full mobile Internet app with profile pictures, scrollable Maps without the extra background, tighter text, and the Windows app name Clearwater Phone instead of Electron.

updates.title: Phone overlay and apps restored
updates.summary: The Phone start screen is a normal window again instead of a black fullscreen, and Messages/Find My talk to Clearwater through the signed-in browser session.

updates.title: Internet page script fix
updates.summary: Removed leftover merge conflict markers at the bottom of Clearwater Internet so the page scripts load cleanly again.

updates.title: Phone API connection fixed
updates.summary: Messages, Find My, Wallet, and Maps no longer fail with a Chromium network error. The overlay now talks to Clearwater through a normal HTTPS request.

updates.title: Staff, business logos, tips, and Phone updates
updates.summary: Ships remove-warning in staff, business logo URLs + idle purge, newest tip in For You, Phone outdated popup, and Clearwater logo on Phone home (v1.3.12).

updates.title: Phone apps work after sign-in
updates.summary: Messages, Find My, Wallet, and Maps can talk to Clearwater again. Sign-in was sticking, but the overlay never had a working API connection.

updates.title: Remove individual warnings in staff
updates.summary: The staff Users panel Warnings list now has a Remove button on each warning or staff notice. Removals can be restored from moderation history.

updates.title: Staff can delete business accounts
updates.summary: In the staff Users panel, business accounts now have a Delete business account action. It removes the business, its posts, and its ads. The linked personal handler account stays.

updates.title: Custom banner uploads removed
updates.summary: Profile banners can no longer be uploaded while Vercel Blob storage is full. Pick a Clearwater scene preset, or remove your banner.

updates.title: Tipped posts rotate in For You
updates.summary: Paid For You tips now show one tipped post at a time. Which tip appears is random, and it switches between the 1st and 2nd feed slots instead of always sitting on top.

updates.title: Phone setup stays open
updates.summary: The first-launch menu no longer closes on its own after a few seconds, and the extra outline around the phone overlay is gone.

updates.title: Government nav hidden without roles
updates.summary: The Government link stays completely hidden unless your Discord roles allow government tools — same behavior as Staff.

updates.title: VPN allowlist for one member
updates.summary: One Discord account is allowed to use Clearwater while on a VPN. Everyone else is still blocked from VPN/proxy connections.

updates.title: Phone stays signed in
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone no longer flashes “Signed in” then immediately signs you out. Discord login is kept until you tap Sign out.

updates.title: Staff PIN fully removed
updates.summary: Ownership and Management open the staff desk with their Discord role only. Leftover PIN code, cookies, and settings notes are gone.

updates.title: @mentions and #hashtags show in blue
updates.summary: In Clearwater Internet posts, @handles and #tags are highlighted in blue again so they stand out from regular text.

updates.title: Fewer API requests, quieter status
updates.summary: Homepage and Internet poll far less often. Status APIs are cached server-side, blocked from casual browser tabs, and heartbeats no longer spam separate presence and warning calls.

updates.title: VPNs and proxies are blocked
updates.summary: Clearwater sign-in and Internet now reject VPN and proxy connections. Turn the VPN off, then try again. Detection is cached server-side so open tabs do not spam lookup services.

updates.title: Government tab and credit fines
updates.summary: A Government tab sits under Settings for the government Discord role. Members can request Clearwater Credit fines, reviewers can approve or deny them, unpaid balances go into debt until later credits pay them down, and actions log to the government Discord channel. Update log posts now include a timestamp.

updates.title: Phone overlay no longer ghosts
updates.summary: The overlay window is opaque, inactive screens stay hidden, and first-time setup no longer stacks overlapping cards or leftover welcome text.

updates.title: Phone Discord sign-in actually sticks
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone now keeps a Discord session the overlay can read. Signing in no longer depends on cookies the desktop app could not see.

updates.title: Phone setup stays on screen
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone keeps the first-launch setup and Launch Phone screens open until you finish. Opening Roblox no longer closes that window.

updates.title: Staff switches keep the side you click
updates.summary: Staff panel on/off switches no longer snap the other way after you click. Saves are protected from background refresh, and a stuck switch now tells you to restart the bot host if needed.

updates.title: Staff ban toggle stays on
updates.summary: Banning someone from the staff panel now keeps the Banned switch on. Ban, mute, and lock actions were writing to a discarded user record and looked like they flipped back off.

updates.title: Internet load cut back
updates.summary: Clearwater Internet no longer reloads the feed, images, and status every few seconds. Likes wait a beat before saving, and rapid like-tapping is rate limited so it cannot stall the server.

updates.title: Phone icons and update notice
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone home icons now match the website (with a new Find My icon). If your phone is out of date, it shows a notice with a link to download the latest build.

updates.title: Poll votes update in place
updates.summary: Voting on a poll no longer reloads the whole Internet feed from /api/internet. The post updates from the vote response instead.

updates.title: Internet API hidden from browser tabs
updates.summary: Opening /api/internet in a browser now returns Not found instead of feed JSON or API error text. The Internet app and Phone still load the feed normally.

updates.title: Staff panel opens without a PIN
updates.summary: Staff with Discord panel access can open the Clearwater Staff desk directly. The ownership and management PIN gate is removed.

updates.title: Homepage status strip cleaned up
updates.summary: Removed the green live indicator and Discord bot latency line from the homepage. Player count and queue still update live.

updates.title: Phone Discord sign-in and setup stay put
updates.summary: Signing in with Discord now copies the session into the overlay instead of only showing a signed-in popup. First-time setup also stays open until you finish, instead of flashing away if Roblox is already running.

updates.title: Phone first-time setup is back
updates.summary: The first time you open Clearwater Phone, you get a setup page to sign in with Discord and choose startup preferences before launching the overlay.

updates.title: Phone sign-in no longer opens the feed
updates.summary: Discord login on Clearwater Phone now returns to the overlay instead of leaving you on the Internet feed in the popup, and the phone stays signed in.

updates.title: Phone Discord sign-in works
updates.summary: Signing in with Discord on Clearwater Phone now keeps you signed in on the overlay so Wallet, Messages, and Internet load your real account.

updates.title: Phone launcher, Internet app, and download
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone opens to a full-screen intro until you click Launch Phone. The overlay now has an Internet app for posting to the live feed, plus settings to start with Windows and auto-launch when Roblox opens. Download Phone is back on the Internet sidebar.

updates.title: Phone overlay uses live Internet
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone now signs in with Discord and uses your real Wallet (transactions, send, request) and Messages. Maps uses the ER:LC map so you can tap a destination and route from your in-game location. Find My shares that location with friends you choose. Marketplace is removed from the overlay.

updates.title: Moderation help cleanup
updates.summary: Removed the “Modeled after Circle-style staff tools” footer from `-help` so the command embed stays clean.

updates.title: Discord update logging
updates.summary: Site and bot changes are now logged to this channel. New updates are queued in the repo and posted automatically when the bot starts (or immediately via the bot API).

updates.title: Update log shows who updated
updates.summary: Discord update log embeds now include an “Updated by” field naming who requested or owns each change.

updates.title: Rank-locked moderation commands
updates.summary: Prefix moderation commands are now locked by staff rank: any staff can warn/mute; Administrator+ can kick; Supervisor+ can ban/softban/unban and lock channels; Lead Moderator+ can purge; Senior Supervisor+ can clear modlogs (`-uwid`).

updates.title: Update log uses git username
updates.summary: “Updated by” in the Discord update log now uses the git/GitHub username (e.g. colin991) instead of a full name.

updates.title: Hold VC command
updates.summary: Added Ownership-only `-holdvc` / `-unholdvc` (not part of the staff moderation command list): server-mutes everyone in a voice channel except Ownership, announces “Please Hold this voice chat”, and plays a bundled voice announcement in the channel (no API key).

updates.title: Hold VC is Ownership-only
updates.summary: `-holdvc` / `-unholdvc` are restricted to Ownership and removed from the staff moderation help list.

updates.title: Hold VC joins and speaks in channel
updates.summary: `-holdvc` now joins the voice channel and plays a bundled hold announcement for everyone in VC (no API key, no Discord text TTS). The bot stays in the channel until `-unholdvc`.

updates.title: Hold VC no longer needs OpenAI
updates.summary: `-holdvc` plays a bundled `assets/hold-vc.mp3` announcement in the voice channel. No OpenAI API key is required.

updates.title: Hold VC is a slash command
updates.summary: Moved hold VC off the `-` prefix toolkit to normal Discord slash commands: `/holdvc` and `/unholdvc` (Ownership only).

updates.title: Say command for voice chat
updates.summary: Added Ownership-only `/say text:` — the bot joins a voice channel and speaks the given text for everyone (no API key).

updates.title: VC action logging
updates.summary: Ownership VC commands (`/say`, `/holdvc`, `/unholdvc`) now post who used them and what happened to Discord channel 1538021552120135731.

updates.title: Roblox group sync retries
updates.summary: Roblox group join-request sync now retries on temporary API failures (like 502) and rate-limits Discord error alerts for those outages.

updates.title: Transparent logo icons
updates.summary: Rebuilt app/home screen icons (192, 512, apple-touch) from the Clearwater logo with a transparent background instead of the dark square fill.

updates.title: Sidebar ad matches site chrome
updates.summary: Sponsored sidebar ads match the solid card surface of What’s happening / Who to follow, and the right rail is a fixed-height independently scrollable column.

updates.title: Notice channel auto-moderation
updates.summary: The no-message notice stays in channel 1515038785421836479 (plain # Notice), links to verification channel 1514181167145025666, increments +1 on every deleted post, auto-timeouts for 7 days, re-sends if deleted, and can be force-refreshed with `-noticerefresh`.

updates.title: Staff Active users tab
updates.summary: The staff panel Active tab lists logged-in members currently on Clearwater Internet (especially the home feed), using live presence pulses with Discord avatar, display name, @username, and Discord ID.

updates.title: Reels photo load fix
updates.summary: Fixed intermittent Reel “photo could not be loaded” errors: same-origin /api/media now proxies Vercel Blob bytes instead of 302ing into a CSP-blocked *.public.blob host, with retries and CSP allowlist updates for large media fallbacks.

updates.title: Business profile editing
updates.summary: Handlers and managers can update an approved business account’s logo, name, type, and about text from Settings → Account (or Edit business profile on the business page).

updates.title: Sponsored ad copy visible again
updates.summary: Sidebar sponsored cards again show body text and Learn/Account buttons: overflow clipping on the right rail was fixed and button/copy contrast was restored against the charcoal card surface.

updates.title: Community pauses contrast
updates.summary: Staff Controls community pause toggles no longer inherit the solid accent button fill, so labels like “Open to members” stay readable on the charcoal panel.

updates.title: Void command and V2 embeds
updates.summary: Renamed `-uwid` to `-void` (old alias still works). Bot replies and logs now use Discord Components V2 containers with no left accent bar color instead of classic embeds.

updates.title: Reel video playback fix
updates.summary: Reel videos now redirect to blob storage for streaming with HTTP Range support instead of being fully buffered by the media proxy, which had been causing black frames and “cannot play here” errors.

updates.title: Staff notice and warning popups
updates.summary: Staff notices now open the on-site alert modal (same as warnings), and unread warnings/notices are checked every few seconds so members already on Clearwater Internet see them without refreshing.

updates.title: Scrollable Internet right rail
updates.summary: The home-page right column (What’s happening, ads, Who to follow) stays sticky and scrolls on its own when the widgets are taller than the viewport.

updates.title: Clearwater Phone overlay
updates.summary: New downloadable Clearwater Phone desktop overlay (Electron) with original icons and wallpaper for Wallet, Marketplace, Find My, Mail, Messages, and Maps. Always-on-top; toggle with F8.

updates.title: Clearwater Phone download on Internet
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone is available from Internet → Phone (and the sidebar card). Download ClearwaterPhone.zip, extract, and run ClearwaterPhone-Launch.bat.

updates.title: Clearwater Phone download more visible
updates.summary: Added a Download for Windows banner on the Internet home feed and a Download Phone button in the left rail so the overlay zip is easy to find.

updates.title: Clearwater Phone Windows exe
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone download is now a single ClearwaterPhone.exe — double-click to open. First launch installs the runtime once automatically.

updates.title: Clearwater Phone portable app
updates.summary: Replaced the console runtime-downloader with a real portable ClearwaterPhone.exe that opens the overlay directly (no black window, no separate download). Windows SmartScreen may still warn once because the app is unsigned — use More info → Run anyway.

updates.title: Clearwater Phone theme cleanup
updates.summary: Removed the home/sidebar Phone promo cards, restyled Phone download buttons to Clearwater Internet colors, and updated the overlay app UI to the charcoal + blue theme.

updates.title: Marketplace, Mail, and premium Phone
updates.summary: Added Marketplace and Mail to Clearwater Internet. Clearwater Phone overlay was redesigned and each app can open the matching website page.

updates.title: Phone settings and auto-update
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone Settings can open apps on Clearwater Internet. The overlay checks for updates, shows an outdated banner, and can auto-download the latest ClearwaterPhone.exe.

updates.title: Clearwater Phone app icon
updates.summary: ClearwaterPhone.exe now uses the Clearwater server logo as the Windows app/taskbar icon.

updates.title: Mail removed
updates.summary: Removed Mail from Clearwater Phone (v1.1.2). Mail was already removed from Clearwater Internet navigation.

updates.title: Phone home uses Clearwater logo
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone home wallpaper now shows the Clearwater logo instead of the old anchor mark. Phone v1.1.3.

updates.title: Pinned post setting removed
updates.summary: Removed the Pinned post dropdown from profile settings. Profiles no longer lift a pinned post to the top.

updates.title: Phone Discord sign-in hardened
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone Discord login now uses a normal browser user-agent, keeps OAuth popups in the same session, and polls until the account sticks (v1.3.2).

updates.title: Phone show-button setting
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone Settings has a Show phone section where you can change the keyboard button that shows or hides the overlay (v1.3.3).

updates.title: Phone updater fixed
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone updates now download with a real browser session, verify the exe file, replace the running app on Windows after quit, and open the download page if Cloudflare blocks the file (v1.3.4).

updates.title: Server Management Load button
updates.summary: Server Management now has a Load action that runs :load on players selected on the map.

updates.title: Business logos use image URLs
updates.summary: Business logos are set with a public https image link instead of file upload. Active business handlers get an inbox notice to update theirs. The Tipped badge is now a flat single color.

updates.title: Business logos + idle cleanup
updates.summary: Vercel Blob is reserved for business logos under 2 MB. Business accounts unused for a week are removed automatically, and their logos are deleted from storage.

updates.title: Newest tip leads For You
updates.summary: The tipped post shown in the 1st or 2nd For You slot is now always the most recently tipped one, still rotating between those two positions.

updates.title: Phone outdated version popup
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone now pops up when you are on an older build and offers Download v1.3.11 (or whichever version is current).

updates.title: Phone home uses Clearwater logo
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone’s home wallpaper now shows the Clearwater logo instead of the old anchor mark. Download Phone v1.3.11 to get it.

updates.title: Discord Internet Panel startup hotfix
updates.summary: Fixed the Discord bot startup import so the Clearwater Internet Panel and weekly department salary service can load together after deployment.

updates.title: Refreshed homepage resource cards
updates.summary: Updated assistance cards with rounded corners, clear icons, colored accents, and keyboard focus styling.

updates.title: Automatic in-game voice channel checks
updates.summary: Added administrator-only /vc checks on/off, enabled at startup, alternating private reminders, a five-minute voice grace period, immediate jail for missing Discord members, and automatic release when they join voice.

updates.title: Keep report download errors inside the admin panel
updates.summary: Weekly PDF downloads now show a readable retry message instead of opening a raw API error. Valid Melonly cached responses remain usable during cooldown and are isolated by API key.

updates.title: In-game priority queue panel
updates.summary: Added administrator-only -prtyq to post the priority queue panel. Eligible voters and boosters with linked Roblox IDs receive temporary moderator access only when a game queue exists, with removal on entry or after ten seconds and recovery retries.

updates.title: Sheriff team capacity checks
updates.summary: The bot now allows up to 23 Sheriff players and marks additional team arrivals wanted with a private team-full notice. Vacancies allow new arrivals, and queued enforcement rechecks the live player list.

updates.title: Role and Roblox enforcement exemptions
updates.summary: Role 1514033074948800683 now bypasses Sheriff capacity enforcement, VC checks, and the secondary server gate. Coleddev13 and notj3dah are exempt from VC checks only. Existing VC-check jails are released when an exemption applies.

updates.title: Sheriff team balance logs
updates.summary: Sheriff capacity enforcement, private notices, exemptions, cancelled checks, and command failures now log to channel 1549178818814812211 with Roblox identity and observed team count.

updates.title: Explain Sheriff enforcement failures
updates.summary: Team balance logs now distinguish failed live checks from rejected game commands, include redacted error reasons and HTTP status, and back off retries after failures.

updates.title: Accepted mod call rooms and staff waiting greeting
updates.summary: Accepted in-game mod calls move the caller and accepting moderator to an empty support voice room. Human arrivals in the staff waiting VC hear the requested spoken message before the bot leaves.

updates.title: Live Discord and voice roster check
updates.summary: Added -dc with the supplied panel style, live online counts, missing Discord, Discord without voice, and voice-connected sections, including callsigns and whitelist labels. Large rosters split across panels.

updates.title: Prevent repeated Discord member lookups
updates.summary: The -dc command, Sheriff balancing, VC checks, mod-call routing, and role sync now share member-list refreshes, reuse the live cache, and respect retry cooldowns instead of issuing duplicate opcode 8 requests.

updates.title: Image cards for Internet posts and replies
updates.summary: Posts and replies now display rendered image cards with profile photos, content, media, and timestamps. Removed the bookmark button. ERLC cooldowns now respect reset headers and response-body retry durations.

updates.title: Dark post cards with follower counts beside the date
updates.summary: Matched post and reply cards to the dark reference layout, moved followers to the timestamp footer, and added the reply recipient inside reply images.

updates.title: Default Discord profiles and additional Internet accounts
updates.summary: Internet starts with a Discord-based default profile and supports additional accounts. Added a restricted follower-count command.

updates.title: Add followers using Discord mentions
updates.summary: The restricted addfollowers command now accepts Discord user mentions and applies the amount to their default account, creating it when needed. Handles still target specific Internet accounts.

updates.title: Shared ERLC event webhook relay
updates.summary: Added a signature-verified event receiver with a durable bot inbox and forwarding retries to Melonly, allowing both integrations to share the game webhook.
